# The Cedar Case

*The lining of the cedar case that keeps the hall's copy of the Open Charter is cracking, and damp is the scroll's worst enemy. Quint wants dry, springy moss-bark from the barkbacks of the Bristlewood to reline it.*

    - Every morning I dust the case. Every week I check the scroll for damp. And this week, for the first time in twenty-six years, I found a crack in the case's lining, the length of my little finger.
